title: GetHomepage Proxmox Configuration
description: Schema for GetHomepage proxmox.yaml. Documentation: https://gethomepage.dev/configs/proxmox/

proxmoxNode.description: Proxmox node configuration. The key is the name referenced by the services’ proxmoxNode setting.

url.description: Proxmox API URL, for example https://proxmox.local:8006.

token.description: API token in the format user@realm!TokenID, for example homepage@pve!homepage.
